subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which open raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path after the proof and serialization blockers are addressed?
rationale: There are two open candidate PRs for the same issue, and automation cannot safely choose the permanent bridge-boundary shape while both remain proof-gated.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if it adopts total serialization, adds a non-JSON regression, and includes accessible real app-server/plugin proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader after-middleware/extension normalization shape and make its proof and CI reviewable.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader after-middleware/extension normalization shape and make its proof and CI reviewable.
